title: Adopt applies the CI workflow and lockfile remediation itself and a refused workflow push becomes a decide record
body: Source: .krn/runs/overnight/fable-direction-1115d.md slice 1. Outcome: adopt writes CI workflow + lockfile from init skeletons instead of filing lane tasks; refused workflow push -> one decide record, not a BLOCKER. Proof: fixtures + local re-adopt of npm and py public rows shows FAIL 0 with no lane. Free. Closes t-p0sgsq7 too.
